The Chinese characters for Hannah

As a transliteration, Hannah is usually written 汉娜 (Hàn nà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Hannah comes from Hebrew and means “grace”.

About the name Hannah

In the Bible, Hannah was the mother of the prophet Samuel.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “grace”, a Hannah calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
